The high dewpoint of 69.8°F signals a humid air mass that adds heat stress but could slightly cap the afternoon peak; light winds of 3.5 mph will limit mixing and allow surface heating to build through peak insolation hours of roughly 1–4 PM ET. The day is tracking close to model expectations with meaningful warming still ahead.
forecast_obs_notes: The four operational models are tightly clustered between 91.8°F (ECMWF, NBM) and 92.8°F (GFS, HRRR), a narrow 1°F spread suggesting good model agreement on the afternoon peak.
